items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: We promoted some dances together and we did a few concerts together.

ctx.x: Did you have any sort of business association with him?

Yeah, we had a lot of little things going together. We promoted some dances together and we did a few concerts together. And, uh, but mostly we bummed around. Yeah. I mean, that was the main... We just had sort of minor deals with him. Mm-hmm.
Well, back to, uh, the actual recording session itself. Uh, how did that go with Burley? Well, very well.

items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: Outside of New Orleans? Dan Burley.

ctx.x: I'd say outside of New Orleans.

Outside of New Orleans? Dan Burley. Of course, Danny Barker outside of New Orleans, too. Pops Foster. And I could never get away from New Orleans rhythm people, for one thing. And it's hard to think of who was the most.
Did you know Wellman Broad at all?
